title: Budget transfers and adjustments
intro: Move budget between lines, or increase or decrease a line. Every one is approved under the budget transfer rule of the DOA.
forbidden: This page is for budget administrators and the heads of departments that own budget lines.
noRule: The DOA in effect has no budget transfer rule, so nothing can be sent.
noRuleHint: A DOA administrator must add a rule for budget transfers in a new DOA version and have it approved before budget can be transferred or adjusted.
noYear: No fiscal year is open today, so budget cannot be transferred or adjusted yet.
noLines: You have no budget line to transfer or adjust in fiscal year {code}.

kindHint.TRANSFER: Move budget from one line to another of the same fiscal year
kindHint.DECREASE: Take budget off one line, giving back what will not be used

list.label: Budget transfers and adjustments
list.empty: No transfer or adjustment you can see yet
list.emptyHint: Transfers and adjustments of the lines you look after will show here.
list.emptyHintSender: Press "Transfer or adjust budget" to start the first one.

form.intro: Fiscal year {code} · once sent, the source line's budget is reserved until it is decided
form.amountHint: No VAT · up to 2 decimals, e.g. 300000 or 300000.50
form.reasonHint: The approvers read this · at least 3 characters
form.draftKept: Saved as a draft. Correct it and press Send for approval again; if the details change, the earlier draft is cancelled for you.

detail.sent: {number} sent for approval. The source line's budget is reserved until it is decided.
detail.openTask: Open the approval task of this transfer
detail.forbidden: You may not open this transfer.
detail.notFound: This budget transfer or adjustment was not found.
detail.pendingHint: Waiting for the approvers of the budget transfer rule. The source line's budget is reserved.
detail.returnedHint: The approver returned it and the reserved budget went back to the source line. Send it again or cancel it.
detail.draftHint: This draft has not been sent and reserves no budget.

actions.label: What you can do with it
actions.cancelText: Once cancelled it cannot be sent. Any budget reserved from the source line comes back at once, and its open approval task closes.

errors.FROM: Choose a source line you may transfer or adjust
errors.AMOUNT: Enter the amount in baht, e.g. 300000 or 300000.50
errors.AMOUNT_NOT_POSITIVE: The amount must be above 0.00 baht
errors.INSUFFICIENT: Not enough budget left: {shortfall} baht short
errors.REASON: Enter a reason of at least 3 characters
errors.DOA_NOT_CONFIGURED: The DOA in effect has no budget transfer rule, so it cannot be sent.
errors.LINES_DO_NOT_FIT_KIND: The lines chosen do not fit the kind. Choose the lines again.
errors.SAME_LINE: The destination must be another line than the source.
errors.UNKNOWN_LINE: This budget line is no longer there. Reload the page and choose again.
errors.LINE_NOT_OPEN: This budget line is frozen or closed. Choose another line.
errors.OTHER_FISCAL_YEAR: Both lines must be of the same fiscal year.
errors.INPUT: Something is missing or wrong. Check every field and try again.
errors.STATE: This transfer has changed status meanwhile. Reload the page to see where it stands.
errors.NOT_FOUND: This transfer is no longer there. Reload the page.
errors.NO_APPROVER: Nobody holds the position that approves this under the DOA. Tell your organization administrator.
errors.FORBIDDEN: Your account may not transfer or adjust this line (budget administrator or the head of the line's department only).
errors.UNAUTHENTICATED: Your session has ended. Sign in again and retry.
errors.BUSY: The system is busy with another task. Wait a moment and try again.
errors.CONFLICT: This was already sent with other details. Check the details and send again.
errors.INTERNAL: Not saved because of a system error. Tell your administrator the reference {requestId}.

task.title: Budget transfer or adjustment to approve
task.heading: {kind} {number}

effect.TRANSFER: Approved, the budget moves from the source line to the destination at once · returned or rejected, the reserved budget goes back to the source line
effect.INCREASE: Approved, this line's budget grows at once · returned or rejected, nothing changes
effect.DECREASE: Approved, the reserved budget leaves this line at once · returned or rejected, it goes back to this line
